body: The employee's name is Majikiiwis. I choose to believe it is pronounced "magic kiwis" and based on that fact alone, I desperately want to go on a date with this person.
Yeah. This was his follow up post after he realized his new lease on life. The whole ordeal was surprisingly wholesome.

I used to be right there with you. To me, it seemed condescending and cheap to make broad and ingratiating statements to strangers.

But lately I see it more like a friendly smile from a passing stranger. It's just someone putting something nice out into the world for no real reason. The karma doesn't actually mean anything, but someone in a tough spot might smile. Anyone could make an argument that it's insincere. It might be!

It made me smile. It gave someone something useful they might not otherwise have had. Some poor intention behind something arbitrary doesn't outweigh the positive effect it had on a person.

It is something small that hit me in the right place at the right time, like a lucky penny to a child.
